ModMetaData.name: More Shader Visuals
ModMetaData.author: assssssqwww
ModMetaData.description:
[b]More Shader Visuals[/b] Adds more shader-based lighting effects to the game. Every effect is drawn by a custom shader with minimal performance cost, and each one can be toggled and fine-tuned individually in the settings.
[hr][/hr] [b]Included Effects[/b] [list] [*][b]2D Gas Layer[/b]: Replaces the cell-by-cell rotating gas sprites with continuously flowing clouds. Can be set to a Blur or Grid style. [*][b]Explosion Shockwave[/b]: Adds an extra expanding ring of air shockwave to explosions. [*][b]Heat Haze[/b]: Hot rooms, fires, torches… slightly distort the view — the hotter it gets, the stronger the distortion. [*][b]Cold Mist[/b]: Cold interiors show slowly rolling cold mist. [*][b]Vacuum Leak[/b] (requires Odyssey DLC): When doors, walls, roofs or other openings leak, airflow streams toward the gap. [*][b]Shields[/b]: Blocked shots send a ripple across the shield, the surface is fully customizable (including a hexagonal dome), and a shield that breaks dissolves away instead of a simple animation. VEF repulsor shields are covered too when Vanilla Expanded Framework is loaded. [*][b]Wind Streamlines[/b] (requires Atmosphere Overhaul): Replaces Atmosphere Overhaul's original streamline rendering. [/list]
[hr][/hr] [b]Save Impact and Compatibility[/b] Can be added to or safely removed from an existing save. Visual effects only. Compatible with most mods.
[b]Performance[/b] Rendering runs on the GPU via shaders, so unless you are using a weak integrated GPU, it has virtually no impact on FPS/TPS. In-game, OverlayMapComponent (this mod) uses about 25 µs of CPU time per frame on average — less than vanilla MainButtonsRoot.DoButtons (40 µs per frame). Note: [b]2D Gas Layer[/b] replaces vanilla gas rendering. It performs worse than vanilla when there is little gas, and better when there is a lot of gas.
